scope: Investigation only: source review and isolated on-device in-memory C benchmark; application code, installed executable and user settings were not changed in this investigation.

scaling.confirmed: Shim always sets scaled dimensions; FBInk rescales on any nonzero scaled size, including identical dimensions. Scaling additionally promotes required 32-bit framebuffer conversion from RGB to RGBA.
scaling.next_change: Set both scaled dimensions to zero only when source width AND height equal target width AND height. Preserve actual resize path otherwise.

gray_framebuffer_path.confirmed: Current FBInk converts grayscale into RGB(A), then loops over pixels again to write its 32-bit framebuffer.
gray_framebuffer_path.limit: Prototype destination is cached ordinary RAM, not the real framebuffer. A framebuffer optimization needs stride, pixel-format, damage, rotation and refresh handling before a latency claim.

chapter_reuse.confirmed: Spine activation discards the outgoing Document and defers a new preparation for every other spine item. Document::into_preparation keeps its pipeline session; PreparedDocument::finish checks current backend/input validity.
chapter_reuse.next_change: Retain one previous engine/document with a byte budget, matching publication/content identity and reader configuration; keep backend generation checks.
chapter_reuse.limit: First visits still require preparation. Benefit and retained bytes have not been measured; the low-level pipeline has memory reports, but exposing a reliable retained-document budget may require facade work.

shape_cache_keys.confirmed: shape_run_cached allocates an owned text key and clones owned attributes before attempting a cache lookup. The backend clears shape-run caches at shaping-batch boundaries.
shape_cache_keys.next_change: Prototype borrowed key lookup or intern complete attribute identities while preserving glyph metadata semantics.
shape_cache_keys.limit: Attribute hashing accounts for roughly 21–27 ms self CPU per captured transition; allocation cost is shared with other work.

line_breaking.confirmed: Current implementation already reuses compact scratch buffers and hoists first/later line width calculations.
line_breaking.opportunity_bound: Halving the measured break_compact_with_mode self cost would save about 24 ms forward or 47 ms backward of CPU in the captured profiling run; not a wall-time guarantee.
line_breaking.next_change: Prioritize retaining unchanged layout before changing the algorithm.
